tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.using: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (app_can_see_client(client_id) or person_id = app_person_id())

membership_unit_ids_check.name: membership_unit_ids_check
membership_unit_ids_check.value: unit_ids is null or (role in ('OWNER', 'APPROVER') and cardinality(unit_ids) >= 1)

membership_viewer_expiry_check.name: membership_viewer_expiry_check
membership_viewer_expiry_check.value: role <> 'VIEWER' or expires_at is not null

person_email_key.name: person_email_key
person_email_key.where: email is not null and archived_at is null

person_email_status_check.name: person_email_status_check
person_email_status_check.value: (status <> 'UNCLAIMED' or email is null) and (status not in ('INVITED', 'ACTIVE') or email is not null)

act_jurisdiction_check.name: act_jurisdiction_check
act_jurisdiction_check.value: (jurisdiction = 'STATE') = (state_code is not null) and (state_code is null or state_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2,3}$')

obligation_jurisdiction_check.name: obligation_jurisdiction_check
obligation_jurisdiction_check.value: (jurisdiction = 'STATE') = (state_code is not null) and (state_code is null or state_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2,3}$')

assignment_na_reason_check.name: assignment_na_reason_check
assignment_na_reason_check.value: applicability <> 'NOT_APPLICABLE' or na_reason is not null

assignment_active_range_check.name: assignment_active_range_check
assignment_active_range_check.value: active_to is null or active_to >= active_from

tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.withCheck: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (client_id is null or app_can_see_client(client_id))

audit_event_actor_check.name: audit_event_actor_check
audit_event_actor_check.value: actor_kind <> 'PERSON' or actor_id is not null

compliance_instance_completed_on_check.name: compliance_instance_completed_on_check
compliance_instance_completed_on_check.value: completed_on is not null or not (workflow_state in ('APPROVED', 'NOT_APPLICABLE') or (workflow_state = 'SUBMITTED' and pending_kind = 'COMPLETION'))

compliance_instance_na_reason_check.name: compliance_instance_na_reason_check
compliance_instance_na_reason_check.value: na_reason is not null or not (workflow_state = 'NOT_APPLICABLE' or pending_kind = 'NA')

import_issue_severity_check.name: import_issue_severity_check
import_issue_severity_check.value: severity = case type when 'PERSON_CASE_MERGE' then 'INFO' when 'PERSON_NEAR_MATCH' then 'WARNING' when 'ENUM_NORMALISED' then 'INFO' when 'UNKNOWN_ENUM' then 'ERROR' when 'ALIAS_DEPARTMENT' then 'WARNING' when 'ALIAS_CATEGORY' then 'WARNING' when 'ALIAS_ACT' then 'WARNING' when 'NULL_PLACEHOLDER' then 'INFO' when 'COMPLIED_WITHOUT_DATE' then 'WARNING' when 'DUPLICATE_PERIOD' then 'WARNING' when 'CONFLICTING_OBLIGATION_VALUE' then 'INFO' when 'RULE_LOW_CONFIDENCE' then 'WARNING' when 'FILE_NOT_ATTACHED' then 'INFO' when 'UNPARSED_EXTERNAL_REF' then 'INFO' when 'INVALID_DATE' then 'ERROR' when 'MISSING_REQUIRED' then 'ERROR' end::issue_severity

tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.withCheck: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (client_id is null or app_can_see_client(client_id))
